episodes.title: INTERVIEW: Leaving a doomsday church at 27
episodes.description: Growing up, Bek Condello never imagined getting old. The strict doomsday church she was born into constantly warned that the world could end at any time. But even though she admits she was terrified, Bek says she never really believed it. So how did she escape this world? And what's it like coming to terms with never seeing your family and loved ones again? In this chat, Bek opens up about her life before and the person she's now become. Bek's book Can You Handle A Girl Like Me? is available from July 14.
